name: backlog
description: v0.1.9: closed backlog id b92a7a77 — project-key notation drift (a bare short label like "aegis" vs its absolute repo path recorded for the SAME project) silently split one project's queue into two under `--project` filtering. `add`/`add_with_weight` now canonicalize a path-shaped `--project` value to its git-toplevel repo root before storing (so `--project "$PWD"` from any subdir/worktree lands on one string), and `project_matches` bridges a bare label already in the store against an absolute path with the same final component, without rewriting existing data. Cross-project task queue with cycle-type tags for Claude Code: a /backlog skill (thin alias to /flow for driver loop), a SessionStart hook that surfaces pending work at session open, and a backlog binary with list/next/done/fail/lock subcommands. The lock→pick→/condukt→done driver loop is consolidated in /flow. Subscription-native (skill + hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).
